facts.full: Charizard takes Pikachu's hat. Sticky soy beef skewers, rice, crunchy slaw.
facts.why: The only support is Pikachu shouting 'Give me my hat back!' as Charizard bangs on the arena gate. The Wikiquote line does not say who has the hat, and no source I opened (Wikiquote, TV Tropes, ComicBook's battle write-up) shows Charizard taking it.
facts.fix: Pikachu takes on Charizard in the arena.
facts.applied_text: Pikachu takes on Charizard in the arena. Sticky soy beef skewers, rice, crunchy slaw.

facts.text: Ryme City, where people and Pokémon live side by side.
facts.why: Not a tagline on Wikiquote or Wikipedia; it is a line built from the Wikipedia plot ('humans and Pokémon live together side by side'). True to the film but not a real poster tagline. It does not print on the card.
facts.fix: Use a verified poster tagline, or keep this line in the about text instead of the tagline field.
facts.applied_text: You feel it in your jellies, don't you? (tagline field, Pikachu's verbatim Wikiquote line; does not print on the card)

notes: Hi-Hat Cafe settled: Looper says Tim and Pikachu visit a diner called the Hi-Hat Cafe, Bulbapedia lists it as a film location and TV Tropes mentions it too. Wikiquote verbatim: 'Second chances are special things, kid.', the coffee slurp and 'Sorry, it's piping hot.', 'These things explode when they're stressed!', 'Silent but annoying.', 'Oh, sweet Mother of Arceus', 'Top 10 Cutest Pokémon', Volt Tackle. Wikipedia: R gas vial in Harry's desk, Torterra, deerstalker. TV Tropes says Pikachu likes his coffee black, so a mocha is a little off but not a claim. Family film: no alcohol; the mocha carries a 'kids skip the coffee' line. Only the poster prints; no stills on this face.

vibe.verdict: A neon Ryme City diner with the coffee, Psyduck and Mr Mime gags landing, but the food is generic cafe fare with Pokémon names stuck on.
